articles.title: X-Caliber Closes $182.2MM Rural PACE-X Financing for Ground-Up Construction of Ultra-Luxury Ski Community in Park City, Utah
articles.mainIdea: X-Caliber Closes $182.2MM Rural PACE-X Financing for Ground-Up Construction of Ultra-Luxury Ski Community in Park City, Utah
articles.summary: Business Wire: X-Caliber Closes $182.2MM Rural PACE-X Financing for Ground-Up Construction of Ultra-Luxury Ski Community in Park City, Utah. IRVINGTON, N.Y., January 12, 2026--X-Caliber Capital Holdings LLC, "X-Caliber," a nationally recognized direct commercial lender and servicer whose affiliates provide mortgage lending, servicing, advisory, and investment solutions, today announced the closing of a $182.2 million Rural PACE-X financing for the ground-up construction of Marcella Landing at Deer Valley, a luxury ski community in Park City, Utah developed by Reef Capital Partners.
